item_short_desc: Rothco's Zipper Boot Laces are designed for those who value both convenience and efficiency in their footwear. Specifically tailored to fit Rothco Combat Boots and Jungle Boots with a 9-hole lace-up design, these zipper boot laces transform your traditional lace-up boots into easy zip-on and zip-off footwear. Simply lace the zipper boot laces into your boots once, and you'll never have to struggle with tying and untying your laces again. The durable construction ensures long-lasting use, even in rugged conditions.
